# Token contract

Every DS token (a custom property) in `@dooph-software/design-system/styles.css`, under the DS's own section headings and in its source order.

## Blocks

| Block | Selector | Cascade layer | Declarations |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| light | `:root, .light` | `ds.tokens` | 289 |
| dark | `.dark` | `ds.tokens` | 84 |
| reduced motion | `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) > :root, .light` | `ds.tokens` | 7 |
| expression defaults | `:root` | `ds.tokens` | 2 |
| practical preset | `[data-ds-expression="practical"]` | `ds.expression` | 2 |

## How to read the tables

- **Light**: the value in `:root, .light`, or in the `:root`-only block for the expression defaults.
- **Dark**: the value in `.dark`. `same` means `.dark` does not declare it, so the light value applies in dark too. `repeated` means `.dark` declares the identical text again, which re-resolves an alias inside a nested `.dark` region.
- **Reduced motion** and **Practical preset** columns appear only in sections where a token is also set in that block.
- **Alias**: `alias` when the light value is exactly one `var()`; `derived` when it computes from other tokens (a `var()` inside `calc()`, `color-mix()` or a shadow).
- **Expression**: `yes` for an expression token, one the practical preset sets to its neutral value.
- **Comment**: the first sentence of the comment directly above the token. A comment that opens a group of tokens (lines between blank lines) and covers more than one of them is shown above that group's table instead. `Dark:` is the comment directly above the token's `.dark` line.
